title: TWSE suspension completeness state is not cryptographically/source-ref bound before CLEAR_NO_ACTION promotion
codeFacts: buildCorporateActionCompletenessReceiptV0_1 accepts suspensionCoverageByExchange as a plain status map and derives suspensionCoverageComplete from TWSE/TPEX == COMPLETE.
The completeness receipt does not require or store an immutable suspension-completeness receipt digest/source identity for each exchange.
The promotion function validates sourceEvidenceRefs only against archiveReceipt.sourceContractResults, which are the three TWSE corporate-action HISTORICAL_ACTUAL_RESULT_RANGE contracts.
No explicit TWTAWU/suspension completeness sourceEvidenceRef is mandatory for CLEAR_NO_ACTION_ELIGIBLE.
archiveReceiptHash hashes the supplied COMPLETE status but cannot prove the status came from a real bounded suspension-completeness receipt.

testCounterexample.finding: The positive CLEAR_NO_ACTION fixture supplies only three sourceEvidenceRefs (SRC-0/SRC-1/SRC-2) matching the three corporate-action source contracts; no suspension/TWTAWU completeness digest is required.
testCounterexample.implication: Current positive tests demonstrate that a plain TWSE suspension COMPLETE status can participate in promotion without immutable suspension evidence binding.

existingGovernanceAlreadyRequiresMore: system2/evidence/S2_STAGE1_NCT01_TWSE_SUSPENSION_NEGATIVE_COMPLETENESS_HANDOFF_20261007_V0_1.json requires the bounded suspension receipt digest to be bound into the corporate-action completeness receipt/sourceEvidenceRefs.

system2/evidence/S2_STAGE1_TWTAWU_BOUNDED_JSON_CSV_PARITY_HANDOFF_20261008_V0_2.json requires both official response hashes and the parity receipt digest to be bound into sourceEvidenceRefs/corporate-action completeness evidence.
risk: A caller can mark suspensionCoverageByExchange.TWSE=COMPLETE and provide valid corporate-action refs while omitting the actual bounded TWTAWU/parity evidence. If all other gates pass, CLEAR_NO_ACTION_ELIGIBLE may be produced with an unproven negative-suspension assertion. This would weaken source lineage and allow a false physical NC-T01 continuity certification.
minimumCorrection: Make TWSE suspension completeness evidence first-class and immutable; a plain string COMPLETE must never be sufficient for physical promotion.

Add an exchange-scoped suspension evidence object/receipt identity to the corporate-action completeness contract, including exact interval, coverage state, receipt/artifact digest, source family/version and observation/availability timing.
For TWSE COMPLETE, require a 64-hex bounded-suspension/parity receipt digest and exact interval equality with the archive/replay window.
Bind that digest into the corporate-action completeness receipt hash.

buildNct01TwseClearNoActionPromotionReceiptV0_1 must require a sourceEvidenceRef whose source identity/digest matches the archive's TWSE suspension evidence identity; absence or mismatch => CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN.
Keep the three existing corporate-action contract refs separately required; suspension evidence is additive, not a replacement.
Do not hard-code 1101 or assume an empty TWTAWU result is complete; DATA_LANE still owns physical bounded completeness proof.
Preserve timing semantics: post-decision prospective observation cannot be backdated; verified source timestamp path remains explicit.
requiredRegressions: TWSE suspension status COMPLETE but suspension evidence object missing -> CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN.
Suspension evidence interval differs from replay/archive interval -> CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN.
Suspension evidence observed after decision under PROSPECTIVE_OBSERVED -> CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN.
Three corporate-action refs complete + valid bounded suspension evidence + exact session evidence -> existing CLEAR_NO_ACTION eligible path remains possible.
Changing suspension receipt digest changes archive/continuity receipt hash.

routing.reason: The defect is in the promotion/evidence-binding firewall, not in the DATA_LANE source acquisition itself. DATA produces the bounded receipt; BUILD must make it impossible to promote without that receipt.

physicalBoundary: This correction can be implemented and verified before DATA produces the first real TWTAWU receipt. Physical S22-T13/T15/T16 remain pending until the real receipt is consumed in one coherent NC-T01 run.
